title: Drain Pipes and Vent Stacks
description: Vents transport sewer gas through the building to open air space. Properly installed vents prevent traps from siphoning and sewage gas from leaking into the interior building. This tool provides reference data for individual vents, relief vents, circuit vents, branch vents, and stack vents, including sizing requirements and maximum length specifications.

## Piping Materials

Materials used in drainage and vent pipes according U.S. standards:

- **ABS Plastic Pipe**: Schedule 40, DR 22 (PS 200) and DR 24 (PS 140)
  - Standards: ASTM D2661, ASTM F628, ASTM F1488, CSA B181.1

- **Cast-Iron Pipe**
  - Standards: ASTM A74, ASTM A888, CISPI 301

- **Copper or Copper-Alloy Pipe**
  - Standards: ASTM B42, ASTM B43, ASTM B302

- **Copper or Copper-Alloy Tubing** (Type K, L, M or DWV)
  - Standards: ASTM B75, ASTM B88, ASTM B251, ASTM B306

- **Galvanized Steel Pipe**
  - Standards: ASTM A53

- **Glass Pipe**
  - Standards: ASTM C1053

- **Polyolefin Pipe**
  - Standards: ASTM F1412, CSA B181.3

- **PVC Plastic Pipe**: Schedule 40, DR 22 (PS 200), and DR 24 (PS 140)
  - Standards: ASTM D2665, ASTM F891, ASTM F1488, CSA B181.2

- **PVC Plastic Pipe** (3.25-inch O.D.)
  - Standards: ASTM D2949, ASTM F1488

- **PVDF Plastic Pipe**
  - Standards: ASTM F1673, CSA B181.3

- **Stainless Steel Drainage Systems** (Types 304 and 316L)
  - Standards: ASME A112.3.1
